definitions.explanation: Materials and tools used for painting or drawing, such as paints, brushes, canvases, and pencils.

examples.japanese: {画材|がざい}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to buy art supplies.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{画材|がざい}の{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This store has a wide selection of art supplies.

examples.japanese: {美術|びじゅつ}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{使|つか}う{画材|がざい}は{各自|かくじ}で{用意|ようい}してくださいと{先生|せんせい}に{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The teacher told us to prepare our own art supplies for the art class.

notes:
Composed of {画|が} (picture, painting) + {材|ざい} (material). A collective term for art and painting supplies. {画材|がざい}{店|てん} or {画材|がざい}{屋|や} refers to an art supply store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画材|がざい}を{揃|そろ}える: to gather art supplies
- {画材|がざい}を{買|か}う: to buy art supplies
- {画材|がざい}{店|てん}: art supply store
- {画材|がざい}{屋|や}: art supply shop
- {画材|がざい}セット: art supply set

EXAMPLES OF {画材|がざい}:
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}: paint
- {筆|ふで}: brush
- キャンバス: canvas
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}: pencil
- スケッチブック: sketchbook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}: stationery — general writing and office supplies
- {画具|がぐ}: painting tools — less common synonym
- {材料|ざいりょう}: materials — more general, not specific to art
